title: Unified Operational System (UOS) Successor Harness Admission State Laws

formal_invariants.statement: An unreviewed, modified, or self-asserted grant cannot activate. The grant document must be equal to the reviewed proposal with review_sha256, proposal_path, and proposal_sha256 bound, validated via same_object/2.
formal_invariants.falsifier: A grant differing by even one field, whitespace object mutation, or unreviewed scope activates successfully.

formal_invariants.statement: The reviewer session_id must strictly differ from the grant target session_id (reviewer.session_id != document.session). Self-review is strictly rejected fail-closed.
formal_invariants.falsifier: An agent generates and signs its own review under identical session identity, resulting in passing validation.

formal_invariants.statement: Only the explicit verdict APPROVE_DEV_TEST_SCOPE is admissible. REVISE, PENDING, or any other verdict fails closed with review_verdict error.
formal_invariants.falsifier: A review with verdict REVISE or non-conforming status allows successor MCP startup or task claim.

formal_invariants.statement: Task resources bound to the coordinator must strictly conform to coordinator regex [a-zA-Z0-9-_.:] with zero slashes. Hash canonical JSON {plan, task} into task:<sha256>.
formal_invariants.falsifier: A resource key containing raw plan slashes passes session_sync valid_resource check or is committed to coordinator.

formal_invariants.statement: Every mutating operation (build, test, write) requires unique intent_id. Replays of identical signatures return cached results without re-execution. Incomplete effects force explicit reconciliation.
formal_invariants.falsifier: An effect with the same intent_id executes side-effects twice or overwrites prior receipt bytes with differing output.

formal_invariants.statement: Task completion via harness_finish requires 13-section journal, verified attestation matching exact candidate manifest and build/test receipt hashes, active risk check PASS, and canonical Sa-plan complete update.
formal_invariants.falsifier: A task completes in Sa-plan without valid 13-section journal, with stale build/test receipts, or without active risk pass.

algebraic_state_transitions: EXECUTING -> (harness_finish) -> COMPLETED (task state completed, Sa-plan result committed)
